decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, Heritage Statement, 1000 Rev 03, 1001 Rev 05, 1002 Rev 05, 1100 Rev 02, 1101 Rev 03, 1102 Rev 02, 1103 Rev 03, 2000 Rev 03, 2001 Rev 06, 2002 Rev 05, 2100 Rev 02, 2102 Rev 02, 2103 Rev 04, 2600 Rev 02, 3205 Rev 02, 3305 Rev 02, 4000 Rev 02, and 4001 Rev 01, received 31 March 2017. 2101 Rev 05 received 7 July 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples/detailed specifications of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted have been submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority. These shall include: the metal roof, low-iron glazing, and timber frame of the proposed extension, and the brickwork of the proposed planter bed. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until the implementation of a programme of archaeological works has been secured in accordance with a written scheme of investigation, including a timetable for the investigation, which has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved details. A written record of any archaeological works undertaken shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority within 3 months of the completion of any archaeological investigation unless an alternative timescale for submission of the report is first agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - All new or replacement rainwater goods shall be of metal construction and finished in black.
Condition : 6 - Angle grinders or other mechanical cutting tools shall not be used for cutting out of stonework, brickwork and / or chasing out of mortar.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
